description: datacarto.datara.gouv.fr: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.datara.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by datacarto.datara.gouv.fr. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Enjeux avifaune et lignes électriques (électrocution et percussion) en; Potentiel hydroélectrique des tronçons de cours d'eau sur Rhône-Alpes ; Mats Eoliennes de Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (service WFS). Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
